name: sergeant-reviewer
description: Sergeant model-free open-source engineering reviewer for VS Code.

viewsWelcome.contents: Open the Sergeant Command Center to review, verify, and inspect this workspace. Models are optional extra reasoning and are disabled by default.

sergeant.pythonPath.description: Python executable used to run Sergeant.

sergeant.provider.description: Optional model-reasoning display preference. Sergeant's permanent officers and normal review remain model-free.

enumDescriptions: Normal Sergeant review. Do not call a model endpoint.
Use explicitly enabled optional model reasoning and fall back to the model-free formation when unavailable.
Owner-selected strict gate that requires optional model reasoning before approval.
sergeant.llmPolicy.description: Optional model-reasoning gate policy. Disabled is the product default.

enumDescriptions: Run the normal model-free Sergeant formation.
After explicit opt-in, discover only approved local model routes.
Use the optional Sergeant Cpl local gateway.
Use Ollama as an optional reasoning engine.
Use LM Studio as an optional reasoning engine.
Use an explicitly configured endpoint as an optional reasoning engine.

sergeant.llmBaseUrl.description: Explicit optional OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Remote endpoints are never auto-discovered; credentials remain environment-only.

sergeant.llmModel.description: Optional model slug. Blank is valid when model reasoning is disabled.

sergeant.llmProtocol.description: Transport protocol for optional model reasoning.

enumDescriptions: When optional reasoning is enabled, use the smallest sufficient support set.
When enabled, allow deeper optional specialist support.
When enabled, allow the largest bounded optional council.
When enabled, use one optional generalist model pass.
Legacy alias for maximum optional council deployment.
sergeant.llmCouncil.description: Optional model-support depth. It does not change the permanent officer formation.

sergeant.cplMaxCouncilMembers.description: Maximum distinct optional model council members when explicitly enabled.
